title: DefineFontInfo2 encoder: wrong bold/italic bytes and missing HAS_WIDE_CODES flag
description: encodeDefineFontInfo2 (packages/swf/src/fonts.ts:530) emits bold and italic as separate UI8 bytes after the flags byte, then a language code byte. But Ruffle's read_define_font_info reads ONE single flags byte where IS_BOLD=bit1, IS_ITALIC=bit2, HAS_WIDE_CODES=bit0, IS_ANSI=bit4, then ONE language code byte (version>=2), then the code table. The extra bold/italic bytes shift the language code and corrupt the entire code table parse. Also the encoder always writes UI16 code points but never sets HAS_WIDE_CODES (bit0); Ruffle reads the table as UI8 without this bit, completely misaligning the tag. Fix: pack bold/italic/ANSI/HAS_WIDE_CODES into a single flags byte. Evidence: ruffle/swf/src/read.rs:1198 (one read_u8 for flags), ruffle/swf/src/types.rs:1259 (FontInfoFlag bit layout). Impact: bold/italic embedded font variants never recognized; code table garbled for all embedded fonts.
